list.word: A huge bridge spans the gorge.
A large badger is under the hedge.
Do not smudge the edge of the page.
I ate a wedge of sticky fudge.
I had to change this fridge.
I had to dodge when the bull charged.
The judge gets paid a high wage.
The sledge will plunge down the slope.
We keep the cage on the ledge.
We will stay in a lodge on the ridge of a hill.
